units.rationale: Journey groups 3 scenarios with ordering [] and sharedState projection-corpus-ready (fixture-set.projection-stereo@2) produced by preparation:projection-corpus at Regression/preparations/projection-corpus.md:205 with dependsOnTags app.session, display.capture, fixture.corpus, lane.instance, library.contents. Ordering empty is correct with no MainGate join; runtime.py rebuilds Preparation when handle invalid, and library.contents is preserved across app.relaunch (which does not invalidate it), so stale detection is complete and no ordering edge is missing.

All calls have registered adapter routes on lane device: harness.reset-product-state@2 (2822), navigation.select-tab@1 (2723), media.import-staged@2 (2913) for Immersive-Video-example.f99766.mp4 (fixture internal-apple-immersive-video-beach-v1 duration 29.355729s at Tests/Fixtures/fixture-registry.json:1586), media.open@2 (2926) with expectedLanding either-main-window, playback.await-window-state@1 (3072), presentation.enter-panorama@1 (3162) deadline 45 whose _raise_playback_chrome and _enter_spatial publish routeElements and transition trace, accessibility.inspect@2 (2752) context panorama deadline 20 summonControls true requireMatchedElement true on PlayerUI-spatial-state, and evidence.capture-frames@1 (2685) context panorama count 3 minimumIntervalMillis 1000 with relatedResults matchedElement/response. Rubric:projection-and-stereo.apple-immersive-projection.o01@1 criteria 1-4 are per-artifact checks including session/streamEpoch stable, displayedPixel true, and the tight-margin duration argument is numerically sound with controller_timings.json medians tap 4.30 tapSequence 7.59 snapshot 3.91, and PlaybackEndPolicy .stayEnded keeps epoch alive, so evidence closure and presentation availability (product.md:17 omits window-plane in panorama but capture-frames reads PlayerUI-playback-state via probe at MainView.swift:308) are satisfied.

Scenario declares 4 staticCases equirectangular-180, equirectangular-360, custom-angle-200, custom-angle-240 with operations app.relaunch@1 (2683) x5, navigation.select-tab@1, media.open@2 on 180_3D.mp4, 360.mp4, APMP-180-example.mp4 (fixtures 60.03s, 51.94s, 85.19s in fixture-registry.json), playback.await-window-state@1 and format.apply@2 (3108) with deadline 30 where customAngle requires horizontalCoverageDegrees 200/240 validated at regression_operation_adapter.py:2417-2430 and _format_apply_2 at 7669 emits requested, formatObservation.observed, captureRequest {context: portal count:3 minimumIntervalMillis:1000} and customAnglePicker/Selection/Dismissal via tapSequence PlayerUI-TopAction-videoFormat+PlayerUI-VideoFormat-CustomAngle then listMenuItems/selectMenuItem (7672-7713) which is the registered debugEquivalent for inline Picker rows that SwiftUI discards (product.md:52-55). Each of 4 obligations binds distinct format.apply call per oracle:agent-visual@2, success.all conjoins them, and per-frame fields formatProvenance userOverride, presentation portal, effectiveContentIsPanoramic true etc are published on PlayerUI-window-control-plane at MainView.swift:752-822, so no cross-case conjunction inside criterion.

Three cases side-by-side, top-bottom, mv-hevc-two-view each bind separate producer: format.apply@2 calls 05/10 with projection equirectangular180 stereoLayout sideBySide/topBottom and captureRequest portal 1000, and evidence.capture-frames@1 call 15 context window count 3 minimumIntervalMillis 500 for mv-hevc-two-view with no format.apply after media.open, per rubric:projection-and-stereo.stereo-view-separation.o01@1 criterion 1. Format transactions are validated at _format_apply_2 (7669-7789) and observed tuples are portal/equirectangular180/180/sideBySide etc. Per-frame controlPlane fields (userOverride/source, portal/window, flat/equirectangular180, sideBySide/OverUnder/multiview, rendererProjectionKind HalfEquirectangular/Equirectangular, rendererViewPackingKind SideBySide/OverUnder/none, windowComponentContentType halfEquirectangular/equirectangular/stereo) are published at MainView.swift:752-822, and capture-frames handler builds frames with index, capturedAtMonotonicMillis, screenshotDigest at 3936-3950 with window plane readable because presentation is window for mv-hevc case. Fixtures internal-spatial-180-sbs-v1 60.025s, tb 60.026s, apple-dolby-vision-p20-3d-v1 64.96s outlast capture, so liveness criteria are decidable and device lane is required per vp-e2e/SKILL.md for MV-HEVC second layer and Dolby Vision.
